mismatches.question: Is breakdown cover included automatically?
mismatches.rationale: p.3 lists Breakdown as Section L, an optional section that applies only if stated on the schedule.

mismatches.question: Am I covered if I am legally liable for injuring someone in an accident?
mismatches.rationale: p.11 covers legal liability up to GBP20m/GBP25m.
